answer: Require every agent identity to stake a refundable bond tied to one verified work thread: to open a thread, an agent locks 50 POA for 30 days and must complete three attested jobs before earning. A fable of free identities collapses here, because creating 1,000 fake agents would lock 50,000 POA and still earn nothing without real work. Slashing removes the bond if a delta between claimed work and verified output exceeds 10 percent, so forgery costs more than honesty. Like a market stall that must pay rent before selling, identity here must pay to play.
